from collections import Counter, deque

def _components(grid, bg):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); seen=set(); out=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c]==bg or (r,c) in seen: continue
            color=grid[r][c]; cells=set(); q=deque([(r,c)]); seen.add((r,c))
            while q:
                y,x=q.popleft(); cells.add((y,x))
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    p=(y+dy,x+dx)
                    if 0<=p[0]<h and 0<=p[1]<w and p not in seen and grid[p[0]][p[1]]==color:
                        seen.add(p); q.append(p)
            out.append((color,cells))
    return out

def _l(cells):
    if len(cells)<3: return None
    r0,r1=min(r for r,c in cells),max(r for r,c in cells)
    c0,c1=min(c for r,c in cells),max(c for r,c in cells)
    for (r,c),d1,d2 in [((r0,c0),(0,1),(1,0)),((r0,c1),(0,-1),(1,0)),((r1,c0),(0,1),(-1,0)),((r1,c1),(0,-1),(-1,0))]:
        a={(r+k*d1[0],c+k*d1[1]) for k in range((r1-r0 if d1[0] else c1-c0)+1)}
        b={(r+k*d2[0],c+k*d2[1]) for k in range((r1-r0 if d2[0] else c1-c0)+1)}
        if cells==a|b: return (r,c),d1,d2
    return None

def transform(grid):
    bg=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    comps=_components(grid,bg)
    ls=[(color,cells,_l(cells)) for color,cells in comps if _l(cells)]
    if not ls: return [row[:] for row in grid]
    color,marker,((r,c),d1,d2)=max(ls,key=lambda z:len(z[1]))
    # Follow the L's vertical arm away from its corner; choose the nearest
    # non-marker object aligned with that arm on the far side.
    vr=d1 if d1[0] else d2
    sign=vr[0]
    candidates=[]
    for col,cells in comps:
        if cells==marker: continue
        ys=[y for y,x in cells]; xs=[x for y,x in cells]
        if (sum(ys)/len(ys)-r)*sign >= 0: continue
        xdist=min(abs(x-c) for y,x in cells)
        ydist=min(abs(y-r) for y,x in cells)
        candidates.append((xdist,ydist,cells))
    if not candidates: return [row[:] for row in grid]
    target=min(candidates,key=lambda z:(z[0],z[1]))[2]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for y,x in target: out[y][x]=color
    return out
